CONSERVATION_AND_ROLLBACK.md:
# Conservation, refusal and rollback

PASS at every requested output and every accepted half-state of all six Node science runs. Independent audits use the unchanged thresholds: global/section mass <1e-8 kg; refrigerant/section/eleven-node/combined thermal energy <1e-6 kJ. Signed donor enthalpy transport and all internal air/tube/fin/refrigerant exchanges are independently recomputed. Original schedules' worst combined residuals: cold 6.325e-12 kJ; warm 1.562e-10 kJ, identical to controls. All raw signed ledgers match exactly. Alternate schedules retain separate maxima in equivalence receipts.

`regressions.json.gz` replays original flow reversal, scheduled/manual boundaries, saturation qualities, superheated outlet, 200/400 K genuine thermal refusals and numerical refusal. Invalid p/h updates preserve the exact original state; direct failed inversion and missing-table-region errors match. Original actual C1 wrapper tests compare candidate/control property engines, with transient/persistent/boundary/record faults explicitly labeled synthetic. These are contract tests, not a new backend or claims of natural physical failure.

The genuine B13/B14 thermal witness accepts to 0.0001 s before a scheduled outward load causes a confirmed domain refusal. Earlier accepted state, exact original physical state rollback and repeated stopped advance match. Separate models stay isolated. `isolation.json.gz` and property ownership receipts provide independent checks.

`external-termination-validation.json` identifies a deliberately CPU-killed child. Its last independently established accepted state is 0.0009236366510514928 s and matches the completed reference. The solver did not complete or demonstrate graceful rollback on process death. Accepted commit, uncommitted trial, numerical refusal, thermodynamic refusal, external kill, Worker/session disposal and physical equipment trip remain distinct. No Worker disposal or equipment trip is asserted; wet indication is not compressor protection.

SUPPORT_DOMAIN_AND_EXCEPTION_PARITY.md:
# Support domain and exceptions

PASS for direct-engine and original thermodynamics-wrapper contracts separately. Tests include nonfinite, undefined/null, booleans, strings, objects/arrays/functions, Symbols/BigInts, signed zeros, negative/out-of-range pressures, extreme enthalpies, exact support boundaries, liquid missing regions, malformed frozen table rows, invalid quality and unsupported phase requests. Original own error metadata and coercion event ordering match; stack locations are runtime diagnostic detail and excluded.

The wrapper checks finite inputs and 0.3–35 bar before PH. The raw historical engine has weaker validation: some NaN/type inputs can return nonphysical/NaN objects. B15 preserves these quirks exactly and does not relabel them validated physical states. No support-band or error-message cleanup is included.

Pressure positivity/log-domain failure remains in initial saturation. Offset checks remain before branch pressure work. Excess enthalpy refusal remains after first branch support interpolation. The local holder is never reached on earlier failures and is discarded on later exceptions. Genuine model update rollback and thermal-domain failures, and actual C1 wrapper metadata, are retained in `regressions.json.gz`; all compare exactly. C1 synthetic fault injection is labeled synthetic and is not natural trajectory evidence.
MUTATION_AND_CACHE_OWNERSHIP.md:
# Mutation and ownership

PASS: changing/deleting/adding fields in a returned property object cannot affect the next result. Successive calls return independent results. Alternating pressures, failed-then-valid inversions, separately constructed engines/loaders, a separate altered frozen table and malformed tables match the control. Default raw factories on mutable custom tables retain original behavior.

The holder is a local object in inverse and is passed synchronously; no engine, table, module, global, result, stage, finite-difference coordinate or model receives it. No previous-call state exists. Source diff and per-call structural counts substantiate that every eligible call constructs its own bracket. In failure it becomes unreachable on stack unwind. Deep-frozen table ownership is guaranteed by the existing table-only factory; bypassing that precondition with an explicit private prototype opt-in is outside the tested path.

`edge-ownership.json.gz` and `browser-edges.json` additionally compare 126 explicit PT phase/kind combinations and 12 alternating calls using a distinctly shifted pressure axis, proving the custom-table witness differs from the original table and neither contaminates the other. These supplement the main corpus. `property-summary.json` records mutation checks. `isolation.json.gz` executes two real models on the same engine with alternating advances and verifies the other state stays bit exact; separate loader properties also match. No Worker/session lifecycle implementation is changed or newly claimed.
MECHANICS_REPORT.md:
# Mechanics

`BRACKET_REUSE_DESIGN_AND_OWNERSHIP.md` records the actual pre-change call graph and was committed before implementation. `build.py` uses unique anchors and verifies exact B9C bytes; module-level SHA-256 proves only engine.js/table-only.cjs differ. `ORIGINAL_VS_CANDIDATE_SOURCE_DIFF.md` shows every statement.

`inverse` receives one primitive p and never assigns to it. The original table factory deep-freezes all arrays/rows before construction. A new holder is scoped to one finite numeric vapor PH call. `branch` still locates the offset first, then uses/constructs the exact [pressure index,weight]. Final `statePT` computes original saturation and temperature-offset classification before passing the same holder to vapor branch. All interpolation math, density logs, bisections, comparisons and h overwrite retain order. No bracket escapes or is installed after failure.

Successful vapor PH: initial saturation bracket + first branch bracket + final saturation bracket = 3, versus 42 original. The two saturation calls deliberately remain. PS/liquid/equilibrium/ordinary PT and nonfinite/coercing inputs bypass reuse. Factory default disables it; candidate table-only explicitly enables it after freezing. Direct opt-in with mutable custom data is outside this experiment's supported ownership path. The original default factory preserves mutable-table behavior.
